newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: NO PLANS FOR COMMERZBANK LINK - CS.
newsitem.headline: NO PLANS FOR COMMERZBANK LINK - CS.

text.p: Rainer Gut, chairman of the Credit Suisse Group said he had no plans to intensify the relations with Germany's Commerzbank AG.

"We have absolutely no intention of intensifying our relations with Commerzbank," Gut said, when asked if the planned merger with Winterthur Group would pave the way for closer involvement with Commerzbank.
Commerzbank co-operates with Winterthur through insurance unit DBV-Winterthur.
News today that Winterthur would merge with Credit Suisse Group sparked a rise in Commerzbank's shares in Frankfurt.
Speculation that Commerzbank is vulnerable for a takeover has been driving the stock higher for months.
On Friday, for example, there were rumours that Deutsche Bank AG, a Swiss bank or another financial conglomerate wanted to acquire Commerzbank. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
